about.title: About Me
about.text1: Software developer with over 3 years of experience in developing, designing, and maintaining production software solutions. Specialized in .NET / C# backend architecture, REST API services, and working with Microsoft SQL Server databases using Entity Framework Core ORM.
about.text2: Strong hands-on experience in production web application development and component-based frontend architecture (React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3). Leveraging solid foundations in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem to efficiently adopt Vue.js framework.
about.text3: Focused on code reliability, performance optimization, technical requirements analysis, and delivering stable software for real-world users.
